About the Scholarship

FundingPartially Funded
StipendAdmission scholarships and differentiated tuition
Application DeadlineAward deadlines vary by programme and award type — see the official scholarships overview
ApplyOfficial application page ↗

The University of Ottawa's scholarships page consolidates entrance awards, international-student tuition exemptions and graduate funding options. Many awards are automatic at admission, while competitive awards follow their own deadlines listed on the overview page.

Programme Highlights

  • Automatic admission scholarships for strong international files
  • Differential tuition-fee exemption scholarships for international students
  • Graduate-specific awards administered by faculties
  • Bilingual institution with a large scholarship portfolio

Who Should Apply

Prospective undergraduate and graduate students applying to uOttawa programmes; eligibility and values differ by level and faculty.

Funding and Costs

Admission scholarships and differentiated tuition exemptions for international students; graduate awards vary by faculty. Confirm the exact funding package on the official page before applying.

Deadline and How to Apply

Review the scholarships-and-awards overview, identify the awards tied to your level, and check any separate application steps before the programme deadline. Key deadline information: Award deadlines vary by programme and award type — see the official scholarships overview.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About University of Ottawa

The University of Ottawa is Canada's largest bilingual university, offering admission scholarships and international tuition exemptions across a broad programme portfolio.

Official website: https://www.uottawa.ca

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: Varies by programme - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
